title: Phantasm
description:
## **Phantasm** — live actors for Skyrim menus

A renderer that draws Skyrim's characters and items on their own: posed, lit and framed, for pages and pictures instead of the game's own view.

**Coming to SkyrimNet**
- In SkyrimNet's next release, OmniSight takes its pictures of characters and items through Phantasm, so the descriptions SkyrimNet writes come from a clean, well-lit shot of the person or the gear, not whatever happens to be on screen.

**In SeverActions**
- Draws the Outfits mirror, the 3D item views and the automatic faces you see across its pages.

**For mod authors**
- Other mods can use it through a small C API.

## Works on Skyrim SE, AE and VR.
author: severause
changelog:
## Phantasm 1.3.0

**Skin**
- Very dark skin tones (Dremora, for one) are as dark as in game, so the body matches the face again
- Skin no longer looks less artificial with texture mods that keep the shine in the normal map; Phantasm reads it the way the game does. The vanilla body looks the same as before

**Characters and creatures**
- Ghosts look like ghosts: blue rim and glow, body and clothes faint under them. Their particles and script-faded ghosts (Katria) aren't drawn yet
- Head shots of creatures with their own head bone (dogs, for one) show the head instead of empty air
- Body mod bone sizes (TNG, SOS, RaceMenu bone scales) now show in the classic pose too, so OmniSight draws them right

**Scenes**
- In multi-actor scene previews, adult body parts now fit the partner they meet instead of passing beside or through the body. Needs XPMSE with your body mod's genital bones; the mouth's placement is still being tuned

**Neural rendering**
- Wide live views (OmniSight's capture) are no longer blurry with NR on. `LiveScale` now means the same on every view: `0.5` = the size shown, `1` = up to twice that. A large wide view costs about 3x the GPU time it did; tall mirrors are unchanged

**For mod authors**
- `Phantasm.log` now lists, once per view and pose, each genital bone's scale in game and as drawn (`MannequinRenderer/genitals:`), to track down a pose that loses a body mod's size
